title: selaginella australiensis var. bakeriana
intro: Selaginella australiensis var. bakeriana, commonly known as Australian Spike Moss, is a species of plant belonging to the genus Selaginella, which is a type of spore-producing plant. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella australiensis var. bakeriana include its ability to act as an adaptogen, helping the body to adapt to stress, as well as its sedative and calming effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
